# Log file format

One log per formal session. Filename: `YYYY-MM-DD HHMM Subject.md`

Do not create logs for small one-off edits unless the user asks for a session closeout.

---

```md
# YYYY-MM-DD HHMM — Subject

## What was done

## What worked

## What didn't and why

## Decisions made
or "none"

## Left unfinished

## state.md updated
yes / no
```
